_note: Descriptions are starter drafts. Verify each against the project's own site before launch; practical notes are left empty on purpose because only a human writes them.

entities.name: Backstage
entities.description: Open-source framework for building a developer portal: software catalog, templates and a plugin system. You assemble and operate it yourself.

entities.name: Roadie
entities.description: Hosted, managed Backstage. Same catalog and plugin model without running Backstage yourself.

entities.name: Port
entities.description: Commercial internal developer portal built around a configurable data model, self-service actions and scorecards.

entities.name: Cortex
entities.description: Commercial internal developer portal that leads with service ownership, scorecards and standards enforcement.

entities.name: OpsLevel
entities.description: Commercial internal developer portal centred on a service catalog, maturity scorecards and campaigns to drive fixes across services.

entities.name: Humanitec Platform Orchestrator
entities.description: Commercial platform orchestrator that generates app and infrastructure configuration from a workload spec. Humanitec also runs PlatformEngineering.org.

entities.name: Argo CD
entities.description: GitOps continuous delivery controller for Kubernetes: reconciles cluster state to what is declared in Git.

entities.name: Flux
entities.description: GitOps toolkit for Kubernetes: a set of controllers that keep clusters in sync with Git, OCI and Helm sources.

entities.name: Crossplane
entities.description: Kubernetes-based control plane for provisioning and composing cloud infrastructure behind your own platform APIs.

entities.name: Kyverno
entities.description: Kubernetes-native policy engine: validate, mutate and generate resources, and verify image signatures, using policies written as YAML.

entities.name: Kubernetes MCP Server
entities.description: MCP server that exposes Kubernetes and OpenShift cluster operations to AI agents.

entities.name: Terraform MCP Server
entities.description: HashiCorp's MCP server giving agents access to Terraform Registry data and, where configured, workspace operations.

entities.name: kagent
entities.description: Open-source framework for running AI agents inside Kubernetes, with tools for cluster and cloud-native operations.

entities.name: K8sGPT
entities.description: CLI and operator that scans a Kubernetes cluster and explains detected problems in plain language using an LLM backend.

entities.name: DORA State of DevOps / AI-assisted development report
entities.description: Google Cloud's annual research report on software delivery performance and, recently, the effect of AI on delivery.

entities.name: State of Platform Engineering report
entities.description: Recurring survey report published by PlatformEngineering.org.

alternatives.note: Same Backstage model; Roadie trades control and cost for not operating it yourself.
Port is configured rather than coded; Backstage gives full control at the price of a team to run it.
Cortex leads with scorecards and ownership; Backstage leads with an extensible portal you build.
OpsLevel leads with catalog maturity and campaigns; Backstage leads with an extensible portal you build.
Both are scorecard-first managed portals; compare on campaign tooling, data model and price per seat.
Both are CNCF-graduated GitOps engines; Argo CD ships a UI and app-centric model, Flux is a lighter controller toolkit.
K8sGPT diagnoses and explains; kagent is a framework for agents that act. Different blast radius.
